text: なんだか　あの　たたかい　かたが　おばちゃんの　このみ　なのよー！

structure.jp: あの　たたかい　かたが
おばちゃんの　このみ　なのよー！

patterns.name: 〜かた
patterns.explanation: かた added to a verb with its ます taken off means 'the way of doing' it. たたかい　かた = 'way of battling'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: なの after a thing word gives the sentence an explaining feel, like 'you see'; ending with なのよ is a womanly way to talk. このみ　なのよー = 'it's my type, you see'.
